about: Verified new shelters for review. Not published. A directory postcode is a referral address, never the pin. A proposal is only listed when an operator or official page names the place and shows a building postcode, with opening times or an access route. Phones are present only when that confirming page showed them; applying a proposal means adding the phone to overrides/phone_baseline.json in a reviewed change. Council-line fields are not set. Women's refuges are excluded and not mapped. Day centres are held candidates (no Day centre map label until that change is on main).
